fields.label: Output VAT Account
fields.description: Account credited when collecting VAT on domestic sales (PCMN 4511 — TVA collectée). One account for all rates; the rate is carried on the invoice line.

fields.label: Input VAT Deductible Account
fields.description: Account debited for deductible VAT on domestic purchases (PCMN 4116 — TVA à récupérer).

fields.label: Input VAT — Investment Goods Account
fields.description: Optional. Separate account for VAT on investment goods (PCMN 4117). Defaults to the deductible account if left empty. Required if the company wants grille 83 to flow correctly without manual classification.

fields.label: Reverse Charge VAT Due Account
fields.description: Account credited for the autoliquidated VAT due on intra-EU acquisitions, intra-EU services and imports under report-of-perception (PCMN 4513 — TVA due sur acquisitions intracommunautaires, declaration boxes 55/86). Also the fallback for domestic cocontractant VAT when no dedicated account is set below.

fields.label: Domestic Reverse Charge VAT Due Account (Cocontractant)
fields.description: Optional. Account credited for the autoliquidated VAT due on domestic cocontractant purchases — art. 20 AR n°1, e.g. construction work (PCMN 4510 — TVA due cocontractant, declaration boxes 56/87). Defaults to the Reverse Charge VAT Due Account if left empty.

fields.label: Reverse Charge VAT Deductible Account
fields.description: Account debited for the autoliquidated VAT deductible side (cancels out the due side when fully deductible). Often the same as the regular Input VAT Deductible Account; can be a dedicated 4956 to keep the autoliquidation legs visible.

fields.label: VAT Settlement Account (Compte courant TVA)
fields.description: Optional. Current account the periodic centralisation OD clears the VAT accounts into (PCMN 4519 — compte courant TVA). GL entries on the VAT accounts whose voucher also posts to this account are treated as settlement transfers, not VAT events, and excluded from the declaration.

fields.label: Journal Entry Base Mapping
fields.description: Route bases booked directly through Journal Entries (periodic takings, corrections, accrued reverse-charge bases) into declaration grids by account. VAT booked on the accounts above is already read from the ledger — map only base / P&L accounts here.
